title: Stripe solutions bento
description: Two-tone heading over a bento of hairline-bordered product tiles (wide + narrow, three across, one full width). Each tile has a light title, a small lavender expand button and a product vignette rising out of a soft colour wash.
notes: phones: one tile per row at 528px tall; desktop: three columns, tiles span 1–3
vignettes come from stripe-mock; the washes use the chart colours
